status: independent discovery acceptance; not alpha or donor readiness
gate: Accept an identifiable distinct operating organization with source-supported current activity relevant to the pinned MSA and a plausible health/welfare mechanism. Exact EIN, live tax status, donation margin and causal cost-effectiveness are alpha, unless evidence shows material sponsor/affiliate conflict or inactivity.

boundary.rule: Only pinned county residents contribute to future edition numerator. Service sites and eligibility establish a discovery intersection, not residence distribution. LA excludes Inland Empire/Ventura; NYC excludes Connecticut, Warren NJ, Dutchess/Ulster NY and all other nonmember counties.

method: Independently read each candidate's identity, source references, geographic finding, mechanism and whole-recipient scope. Reopened or independently searched selected primary pages where identity or geography could change acceptance. Most author primary-source checks are reused transparently, not represented as reopened. No full 990 or revocation audit.
